main_body: bar stool with round red padded cushion and four metal legs
top_band: light pink/salmon and medium red top of cushion on rows 2-4
evidence: Round stool cushion shows a 3-row elliptical top surface (rows 2-4 in light salmon and coral) above a darker red front rim (row 5) and deep maroon bottom edge (row 6), supported by metal legs set back underneath on rows 7-15.

style.evidence: The cushion uses a 4-step red ramp (salmon highlight, coral mid, red front rim, deep maroon outline) and legs use 3 grey tones plus dark feet. However, compared to the reference props, the shading is quite simple and pillowy on the cushion, and the single-pixel un-outlined grey legs look somewhat thin and sketchy against the background.
